payload.title: Provider exception text is persisted as “message_redacted” without redaction
payload.description: The new calibration path records and emits raw provider exception text via `str(_exc)` while labeling it `message_redacted`. Provider errors can include request details, prompt fragments, account identifiers, model/provider response bodies, or operational metadata. This is especially risky because the value is added to `_modelinv_state["models_failed"]` and also included in stderr JSON. Use a redaction helper or structured safe fields from `ChevalError` instead of raw exception strings.
